name: wait-on-prompt
about: a robovac session's second turn asks to run a command, and the person answers after 30 s

steps.prompt: /robovac Use the Bash tool to run exactly: {runs} say "verifying the wait on a prompt" . Then reply with only the word ready.
Use the Bash tool to run exactly: touch waited.txt . Then use the Bash tool to run exactly: sleep 8 . Then reply with only the word done.
